metaDescription: Order custom 11 oz wine glasses for your next event. Perfect for tastings and parties. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom 11 oz wine glasses offer a versatile size for wine tastings, corporate parties, and promotional events. This capacity splits the difference between a standard pour and a full glass, making it ideal for sampling flights or controlled servings. Choose from stemless or stemmed styles in glass or durable plastic, and add your logo with screen printing or etching. Bulk orders ensure consistent branding for your next gathering.
heroAltText: Custom 11 oz wine glasses with engraved logo, stemless design, perfect for corporate events and wine tastings
